container.simpleblocks.shaping_saw.empty: Put stone, wood or wool in on the left
container.simpleblocks.shaping_saw.no_cu: Nothing to cut from this item
tip.simpleblocks.shaping_saw: Cuts stone and wood into stairs, slabs and more
jei.simpleblocks.info.shaping_saw: Upgrade a placed stonecutter: use an axe on it (with Simple Hammers a hammer instead) while you carry 4 iron nuggets. The nuggets are used up and the stonecutter becomes a Shaping Saw facing the same way.
simpleblocks.guide.page.1.title: Simple Blocks
simpleblocks.guide.page.1: The missing building blocks: Hushed Deepslate Tiles that swallow vibrations like wool, Sculk Deepslate, the missing Vanilla
simpleblocks.guide.page.2.title: Simple Blocks
simpleblocks.guide.page.2: stairs, slabs and walls, cracked and mossy bricks and the Shaping Saw, which cuts stone and wood.
simpleblocks.guide.page.3.title: Shaping Saw
simpleblocks.guide.page.3: The Vanilla stonecutter with copper fittings, for stone AND wood: it cuts everything the stonecutter cuts, plus planks, logs, wool and every other block whose stairs or slabs the stonecutter cannot make.
simpleblocks.guide.page.4.title: Hushed Deepslate Tiles
simpleblocks.guide.page.4: Deepslate tiles that swallow vibrations like wool: a Sculk Sensor or Warden does not hear a vibration that passes through the block, and walking on it makes none.
simpleblocks.guide.page.5.title: Sculk Deepslate
simpleblocks.guide.page.5: Deepslate with sculk veins. It is not generated in the world: craft it or find it in Ancient City chests.
simpleblocks.guide.page.6.title: Missing Stairs, Slabs and Walls
simpleblocks.guide.page.6: Stairs, slabs and walls Vanilla lacks: Calcite, Netherrack and Smooth Basalt (all three), Cut (Red) Sandstone stairs and walls, Smooth (Red) Sandstone walls.
simpleblocks.guide.page.7.title: Cracked and Mossy Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.7: Aged variants of Vanilla bricks that have none: cracked Red Nether, Tuff, Mud, End Stone, Cinnabar
simpleblocks.guide.page.8.title: Cracked and Mossy Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.8: and Sulfur bricks; mossy Tuff, Mud, End Stone, Cinnabar and Sulfur bricks, mossy Deepslate Bricks and Tiles.
simpleblocks.guide.page.9.title: Blue Nether Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.9: A blue counterpart to Red Nether Bricks, with stairs, slab and wall.
quests.simpleblocks.start.title: Welcome to Simple Blocks
quests.simpleblocks.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleblocks.start.welcome.title: A free guide
quests.simpleblocks.start.welcome.descri: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Blocks Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a clay ball.
